preconditions.description: The number of words in the scroll must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(word) <= 20000 for word in words)
preconditions.description: Each word must have a length of at least 1 and the total length of all words must not exceed 20000.
All words must consist of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of valid variants of the original scroll modulo 10^9+7.
